description: Aircraft and Cargo Activity at Hamad International Airport is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. Annual aircraft movement (arriving and departing) and cargo & mail volume (received and dispatched, in tons) at Hamad International Airport. Consolidated from the annual bulletins, covering 2012-2022. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are airport, Air freight. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-06-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and air transport studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
